description: Service Global Footwear Limited (SGFL) is a footwear manufacturer incorporated as a public limited company on 19 July 2019 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It manufactures, markets, imports and exports footwear, leather and allied products, and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Service Industries Limited. Its head office is Servis House in Main Gulberg, Lahore.
headOffice: Servis House, 2 Main Gulberg, Lahore 54662, Pakistan
